chapter_seo_title: Immortal Fortunes Assembly Top 12 Revealed! Ji Ning's Hidden Power & Time Cultivation
chapter_meta_description: The Immortal Fortunes Assembly top twelve are decided! Ji Ning's victory reveals a hidden strength ability. The Xia Emperor rewards them with Primordial Liquid and a three-day cultivation retreat with altered time.
og_title: The Final Twelve Prepare for Battle in the Immortal Fortunes Assembly!
og_description: The finalists are set! Ji Ning proves his might, earning a three-day accelerated cultivation retreat to push his limits before the final clash for Daofather Crimsonbright's favor.
twitter_title: Top 12 Finalists Announced! Ji Ning Gets Secret Time-Space Training!
twitter_description: The Immortal Fortunes Assembly top 12 are set! Ji Ning’s victory reveals a hidden strength ability. The Xia Emperor gives them 3 days of training in 1 hour!

lore_anchors.definition: A high-level Immortal whose soul and body have been completely purified of Yin, achieving a state of pure Yang. They are the peak of power in the Three Realms below the ultimate Daofathers and Chaos True Gods.

The ultimate pinnacle of Ki Refining cultivation in the Three Realms. A Daofather has fully comprehended a Heavenly Dao and is a ruler of cosmic laws, capable of creating worlds and taking disciples of their own.

surfaces: Ten million jin of Primordial Liquid
lore_anchors.definition: An astronomical sum of cultivation resources. This amount of pure energy is enough to push a cultivator through multiple major stages, making it a reward befitting the utmost geniuses of the empire.
One of the most profound and difficult Heavenly Daos to comprehend. Even a slight mastery, like altering the flow of time for a small group, is a display of immense power and understanding.

A high-level magic treasure capable of creating an independent world. The Xia Emperor uses his power to alter the time flow *within* this world, giving the finalists a precious cultivation opportunity.
A proud genius of the imperial Xiamang clan. He represents the pinnacle of the royal family’s younger generation and is one of the four tribe-back finalists in the top twelve.
A mysterious and freakishly durable female rogue cultivator. Her treasure-like body makes her almost impossible to injure, a terrifying advantage in a tournament setting.
